jobs.description:
What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

📦 Warehouse Worker in 2 Shifts Wanted – Do you enjoy active work in a dynamic environment?
 

Are you someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys an active job? For a growing logistics company in the frozen food sector, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers who want to work in a well-organised warehouse.
 

Your tasks:
 

 
• Picking products using voice picking or a scanner
 
• Preparing orders for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• You have experience as a warehouse worker or are motivated to learn
 
• You have experience with an electric pallet truck
 
• You work safely
 
• You speak Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to work in a freezer environment

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Forum is looking for Operators in Zottegem urgently! 
Your responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and reconfiguring production equipment on a production line.
• You will be able to work on various machines.
• You will clean the machines, equipment, and conveyor belts.
• You will be responsible for quality control.
• You will work in two shifts, Monday through Friday (6:00 AM–2:00 PM and 2:00 PM–10:00 PM).

Who are you?

• You have a technical background, either through a degree or work experience
• You have some initial experience as a technical operator
• You are motivated
• You have a consistent work history
• You speak English well

For our client in Roeselare, we are looking for a sandblaster. What will you do?
 
 
 
• Sandblasting iron components in a blasting cabinet 
 
• Masking off parts 
 
• Moving parts that need to be sandblasted indoors and outdoors using a forklift 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• Experience as a sandblaster is required 
 
• Ability to work independently 
 
• A forklift certificate is a plus 
 
• Minimum knowledge of English

Ready to take charge of your own CNC machine and produce high-quality parts?

Your Responsibilities:

• Inspect and adjust first pieces as needed
• Move large workpieces using an overhead crane (certification is a plus, training can be provided internally)
• Work on a fixed machine and fully utilize your expertise
• Program directly at the machine
• Independently produce hydraulic components on CNC machines
• Read technical drawings and determine the optimal workflow

Your Profile:

• Read technical drawings and plan the machining sequence
• Experience with overhead cranes or willingness to learn
• Strict adherence to safety regulations
• Precise and skilled with measuring tools
• Able to program and set up machines independently
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French, or English
• Experience as a CNC milling operator or machinist

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability.

 

You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)

·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality

·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude

·        A professional and presentable appearance

·        Proficiency in Dutch or English

·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

Our client, located in Tildonk, near Leuven, is an ideal partner for the purchase and sale of second-hand buses.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Bus Cleaner;

As a Bus Cleaner, you will be responsible for thoroughly cleaning, stripping and refitting buses according to the customer's requirements. You ensure that every bus is completely clean and ready for collection by the customer. You work accurately according to the prescribed cleaning and safety procedures and contribute to maintaining a high standard of quality. You will report directly to the Logistics Manager;

What will you do?

• Clean and maintain cleaning equipment.
• Prepare cleaning products and equipment.
• Mark off slippery areas.
• Clean and restore surfaces and floors by stripping, scrubbing and polishing.
• Clean surfaces using a carpet cleaner and carpet cleaning machine.
• Clean and renovate surfaces and floors using soap cleaning methods.
• Clean surfaces using cleaning equipment, high-pressure machines and pressure washers.
• Remove waste (household and industrial).
• Take waste bins and containers outside for collection.

REF: MEC1

Who are we looking for?

• Experience in industrial cleaning and with professional cleaning products and equipment is a plus.
• Knowledge of safety regulations and the correct handling of chemical substances is a plus.
• You are accurate, independent and reliable
• Good physical condition and manual dexterity
• You are able to work in confined spaces, depending on the tasks.
• You are comfortable working in a workshop environment, as well as outdoors in both summer and winter.
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
• You are able to work under time pressure
• You are comfortable working in a multicultural environment
• You speak Dutch, French or English

Our client, located in the Mechelen region, specializes in the production and printing of paper, cardboard and polyethylene packaging.

We are looking for a motivated person to join the team. You will be responsible for producing and packaging various types of paper and cardboard packaging for the food industry.

• You produce and package various types of paper and cardboard packaging for the food industry.
• You set up the machine according to the packaging to be produced.
• You are responsible for your machine, check the settings and make adjustments when necessary.
• You keep track of production data and follow up on production orders. 
• You work closely with the technical team regarding planning, deviations and maintenance.
• You carry out quality checks on the products to detect any deviations.
• You are a reliable member of a close-knit team and contribute to ensuring production continuity.

REF: MEC1

• You have at least a few years of experience as a Technical Line Operator
• You have experience working with mechanical production machinery
• You have a stable employment history
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch, French or English.

Alpaflow is seeking an enthusiastic mind to develop and integrate complex software stacks.
You will participate in the design and shipping of data processing products, manufacturing systems or IoT solutions for our industrial clients. 

We promise: it won't involve a cheap ChatGPT integration to check the ¿LLM powered¿ box in a marketing description ;)
 Requirements
• You like to work in an industrial ecosystem, or you are eager to discover it.
• Master's degree in engineering or computer sciences (or equivalent experience). You have 5+ years of experience building and shipping software projects.
• You like your users, you like meeting them and learning from them.
• You have several years of experience using Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Linux, Git, Networking, AWS or GCP.
• You know a high-level programming language (Python, Go, Java, R...), SQL and are willing to learn Python.
• Creative spirit/hacker, you like doing things by yourself.
• Fluency in French and English is required. Nice to have
• Previous experience in: 
• applied research around robotics;
• artificial intelligence; 
• data engineering;
• industrial software development or integration.
• You know how to use a machine learning framework (eg. Pytorch).
• You worked with manufacturing or energy data systems. You know what a manufacturing operations management solution, a unified namespace or a warehouse management system is.
• Knowledge of Clickhouse, Django or Flask, Gitlab, streaming and batch data processing.
• Previous experience of data analysis with Jupyter/Pandas... We offer
• You can work from anywhere in Belgium.
• You pay a visit to our office in Brussels (Ixelles) from time to time (~1 day/week). If you prefer, you can work there on the other days too.
• You'll have to move from client site to client site, in the zone located between Nivelles, Louvain-la-Neuve and Liège, sometimes several times a week.
• Phone, laptop, Internet, flexible mobility budget (bike, car, transit pass...) based on your needs.
• Competitive compensation (~3200-3600€ net/month, depending on perks) in a permanent contract (CDI).
• All the perks of CP200 (eco-vouchers, 13th and 14th salary...).
• DKV insurance & dental for you and your family.
• We have flexible working hours.

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.
 

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.
 

Your tasks and responsibilities
 

 
• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
 
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
 
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
 
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
 
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
 
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment. 

 
• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
 
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
 
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

Our client is a specialized consultancy company with a unique market position, having worked exclusively with the same international aviation industry leader for more than 15 years. This long-term partnership offers an exceptional combination of stability, expertise, and continuous technological evolution.Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

As a Data Engineer / BI Consultant, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's data ecosystem.Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines within a Snowflake environment.
• Working with SQL and Linux/Bash to support data integration, automation, and transformation processes.
• Implementing and maintaining solutions within a modern Data Mesh architecture combining Data Lake and Data Warehouse principles.
• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of data flows and reporting solutions.
• Collaborating closely with international business stakeholders located across multiple countries and time zones.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into sustainable and efficient data solutions.
• Supporting the continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and Business Intelligence capabilities.
• Contributing to data quality, governance, and optimization initiatives.
• Participating in ongoing projects related to cloud data platforms and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills and enjoys working in an international environment.We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or a similar domain.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake at an intermediate level.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SQL
• Linux/Bash
• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.
Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Our client is a growing logistics company in the textile industry. The company has positioned itself internationally as an important player in the sector and continues to develop rapidly. With a strong focus on customer orientation, they provide solutions in the logistics chain. Due to their rapid growth, they are looking for enthusiastic and driven employees who can contribute to their further expansion.

Jobomschrijving

As a Back-up Team Leader, you are the right hand of the team leader. You take over responsibilities during their absence and assist in managing a warehouse team on a daily basis. Together, you ensure smooth operations, high quality, and a positive working atmosphere.

Your responsibilities:

• Support and replace the team leader in daily operations
• Coordinate and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety
• Report progress and issues to management
• Contribute ideas for process improvements

Do you recognize yourself in the items listed below:

• experience in logistics or warehouse operations
• leadership skills with a hands-on mentality
• Communicates in both Dutch and English
• flexible
• Works well under pressure and is solution-oriented

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. While you won't be writing production code day to day, your credibility with the team comes from having built and operated systems like these yourself.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Bring deep, hands-on experience with our stack or equivalent (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services), enough real depth to debug a production issue or challenge an architectural decision yourself, not just follow the conversation.  Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Several years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, Architect, or DevOps/Platform Engineer, ideally followed by a move into a people-management or tech-lead role. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You are a key point of contact on the work floor and maintain an overview of the day-to-day logistics operations. At the same time, you take an active, hands-on role in the work yourself.

 
• 
You operate a forklift, reach truck and pallet truck and assist wherever needed.

 
• 
You maintain an overview of the logistics operations and organise the work to ensure everything runs smoothly.

 
• 
You guide and supervise colleagues in a clear and positive manner.

 
• 
You monitor safety, quality and the correct execution of all activities.

 
• 
You accurately scan labels and storage locations and ensure that all movements of goods are correctly registered.

 
• 
When deviations or unexpected situations occur, you respond quickly and take a practical approach to finding solutions.

 
• 
As a key point of contact on the work floor, you contribute to effective teamwork and cooperation.

 
• 
You help ensure that logistics operations are carried out efficiently and in an organised manner.

Ready to take responsibility, support your team and get the job done? You can read below what we are looking for.

 
• 
You have experience in a logistics or warehouse environment and are familiar with day-to-day warehouse operations.

 
• 
You have experience supervising, guiding or coordinating employees.

 
• 
Working hands-on alongside the team is an important part of this position and is something you are comfortable with.

 
• 
You have practical experience operating a forklift and/or reach truck and hold the required certificates.

 
• 
Experience with a pallet truck is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 
• 
You are able to maintain an overview, set priorities and adapt quickly when schedules or circumstances change.

 
• 
You communicate clearly with colleagues and are able to guide employees in a positive manner.

 
• 
You actively monitor safety and quality on the work floor.

 
• 
You communicate well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is important because you will be supervising logistics employees who speak Dutch, English or French.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Are you driven by people, motivated by success and energized by building relationships? Do you enjoy spotting opportunities, making things happen and working in a team where ambition and collaboration go hand in hand? Then this could be your next career move. 

Your role

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll be part of our Interim Management team, working at the intersection of people, business and opportunity.

You'll manage the recruitment process from start to finish, while building long-term relationships with organizations and professionals. No two days are the same: one moment you could develop a new business opportunity, the next you're speaking with an experienced professional about their next career move.

As a Recruitment Consultant at Robert Walters, you'll combine your commercial drive with your passion for people. You'll connect organizations with experienced professionals, develop your own network and play a key role in helping businesses find the expertise they need.

We are looking to strengthen our Interim Management team in Antwerp (Berchem). If you're ambitious, entrepreneurial and ready to take ownership of your career, we'd love to meet you.

You'll have the opportunity to:

• Build and grow your own network of organizations and professionals within the Interim Management market
• Identify new business opportunities by understanding what organizations need and where you can add value
• Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with business partners
• Search for, assess and connect experienced professionals with the right interim management opportunities
• Manage the recruitment process from first contact through to successful placement
• Arrange interviews and ensure clear, proactive communication throughout the process
• Meet with prospective business partners and deepen existing relationships
• Proactively develop your portfolio through networking, market outreach and business development
• Work closely with your colleagues, sharing market knowledge, ideas and expertise
• Contribute to the success of the wider team while building your own track record
You'll have real ownership, clear targets and plenty of opportunities to make an impact.

 

 

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, ambitious and genuinely interested in people.

You'll bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree combined with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience within finance / operations
• Excellent Dutch and very good English communication skills
• A strong commercial mindset and a genuine drive to achieve results
• An entrepreneurial attitude and the confidence to create and pursue new opportunities
• Strong negotiation skills and a strategic approach
• A natural interest in business, people and the world of work
• A strong team spirit and a collaborative mindset
You're someone who takes initiative, enjoys a challenge and isn't afraid to pick up the phone or open a new door. You know how to build trust, you're comfortable working towards targets and you're motivated by seeing the impact of your work. Above all, you're looking for more than just a job: you want to build a career where your ambition can grow with you.

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Business Analyst Manufacturing Transformation
jobs.description:
I am currently supporting a client leading international industrial manufacturing organisation based in Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join a major business transformation programme.

The organisation is undertaking a significant transformation of its core business and operational processes, including the modernisation and harmonisation of ERP, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics and related business systems.

This is a business-critical transformation programme involving multiple stakeholders across manufacturing sites and functions, with a strong focus on process standardisation, operational efficiency and the transition from legacy ways of working to a modern target operating model.

Terms

 
• Freelance / Long-term contract - 12 months, with possible extensions
 
• Location: Antwerp, Belgium
 
• Hybrid: 2 days on-site per week
 
• Language: English-speaking (Dutch is beneficial)
 
• Rate: Negotiable depending on experience

Key responsibilities

 
• Analyse and document current AS-IS manufacturing and supply chain processes
 
• Define and document TO-BE processes as part of the transformation programme
 
• Lead requirements gathering across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics and Operations
 
• Facilitate workshops with business process owners, subject matter experts and key stakeholders
 
• Identify process gaps, inefficiencies and opportunities for standardisation and improvement
 
• Translate business requirements into clear functional requirements and specifications
 
• Perform fit-gap analysis between existing processes, business requirements and the target ERP / business systems
 
• Support the design and implementation of harmonised processes across multiple manufacturing sites
 
• Work closely with ERP functional teams, solution architects, technical teams and implementation partners
 
• Support integration and process dependencies across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Warehousing and Logistics
 
• Contribute to data migration, testing, UAT, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities
 
• Ensure business requirements and process documentation remain aligned throughout the transformation
 
• Act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and technical / implementation teams
 
• Support change adoption and the transition to the new processes and systems
 
• Manufacturing / supply chain experience - essential
 
• Candidates must have experience within a manufacturing environment, ideally within industrial / discrete manufacturing.

Strong experience across areas such as:

 
• Production planning and scheduling
 
• Manufacturing operations
 
• Supply Chain
 
• Procurement
 
• Inventory / materials management
 
• Warehouse and logistics
 
• MRP / planning processes
 
• Order-to-delivery processes
 
• Manufacturing master data
 
• Plant / site operations
 
• ERP-enabled manufacturing processes
 
• Experience working across multiple manufacturing sites or international operations would be highly advantageous

Project context

 
• Major manufacturing transformation programme
 
• International industrial / discrete manufacturing organisation
 
• Antwerp-based with multiple operational / manufacturing stakeholders
 
• Transformation of legacy business processes and systems
 
• Strong focus on ERP, Manufacturing and Supply Chain transformation
 
• Harmonisation and standardisation of processes across sites
 
• Transformation covering...
...

• Strong experience as a Senior Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Functional Analyst or ERP Business Analyst

• Proven track record delivering business transformation, ERP implementation, migration or rollout programmes

• Excellent experience with AS-IS / TO-BE process mapping and fit-gap analysis

• Experience facilitating workshops with senior business stakeholders and process owners

• Comfortable working between business, functional and technical teams

• Experience working with systems integrators / implementation partners

• Experience across testing, UAT, data migration and go-live activities

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Professional working English

We’re recruiting for a company in Ruiselede that specializes in sustainable and energy-efficient installations.

Do you value sustainability? Do you want to make a meaningful impact on your community?

Then be sure to read on!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll be responsible for installing charging stations, heat pumps, and solar panels
• You’ll perform installation work
• You’ll work on-site, departing from Ruiselede at 7:00 a.m. 

Who are you?

• You have experience in the construction industry
• You’re not afraid of heights

Our client is an international player in modular systems for events, stand construction and so on.

Duties:

- grinding and deburring of aluminum profiles.

- alternating between serial work and piece work

- entering and processing orders in the computer

You have experience within the metal sector or have completed technical studies.

You can work with the computer

You have a good command of the English language
